BACKGROUND: floor-to-ceiling arched pre-war windows filling the upper third of frame; through the glass, a global-modern city skyline (composite: Dubai-style + Singapore-style — glass towers with curving forms + traditional limestone buildings mixed). No readable screen content, no readable branded signage. Register: corporate luxury.
